posts.text: This past weekend, my teammates (Jashan Pratap Singh, Harkit Singh Chhabra and Van Nguyen) and I went to Hack the North. It was an interesting learning experience, even though we thought we had a winning idea, as it turns out, just having a good idea does not equate to a win but, being able to effectively communicate and sell that idea to the judges is just as important. Looking back, I also realize, we did not fully follow, Albert Chen's advice, "do 100% of 70% instead of doing 70% of a 100%."

This Weekend at the University of Waterloo me, Andrew Deng, Krish Nalam and Emily Yu participated as a team at Jamhacks, Waterloo's Largest High School Hackathon. We're proud to say that, our project Fitris scored Third position. https://lnkd.in/gng9aRYp
